new.name: Weapon Bulwark: durability the circling weapons lose per point of damage they take off a hit reaching you (less with minion life)
Living Steel: durability a living weapon's item loses per blow it lands (a swing in the hand loses 1)
Living Steel look: strength of the ember glow on the weapon's edge, its light and the sparks off its tip (0 none)
Living Steel look: scale of the living motion - hover, drift, wind-up, lunge, the bow of the flight back (0 holds the weapon in the hand's pose)
Living Steel sound: volume of a living weapon's own sounds - the hover hum, the whoosh of the lunge, the ring of its tip (0 silent)
Living Steel look: width and life of the hot trail behind a fast-moving weapon (0 none)

old.name: Living Steel: health of a living weapon per point of its item's durability, before minion life

new.name: Living Steel: a living weapon senses enemies only this much short of the leash, so it never engages what it would be pulled back from
Quiver on the back: lean back at the top
Quiver on the back: tilt from vertical, top toward the right shoulder
Quiver on the back: mouth to the right of the chest bone

old.name: Quiver on the back: sideways offset

new.name: Quiver on the back: mouth above the chest bone

old.name: Quiver on the back: height offset

new.name: Quiver on the back: mouth behind the chest bone

old.name: Quiver on the back: distance behind

new.name: Wanderer: uniques of the place's level per gift offered (6 of a pool of 12 or more, never fewer than 3)
